thread.listingTitle: Standard room at Brisbane City, Brisbane

messages.text: Hi! My name is Gabriel, I’m 28 years old. I’m a friendly, respectful and very clean person. I like to keep shared spaces tidy and I’m easy to live with. I’m responsible, quiet and I always respect house rules. I’m looking for a peaceful place to stay and a good environment with the people in the house. Please let me know if the room is still available. Thank you!
